Karen Dobson and Paul Hendry have nothing in the inbox that supports a change, so both stay UA. A note might be added on Paul’s dentist claim, but it would not alter the code.

Ryan Whitaker is the exception. His email rules out SC, and a sister who does not live with him is outside the written DEP and BRV definitions, so the residual code is UA. That second probation UA would generate a dismissal letter the same day. With the HR manager out, team leaders on the floor until 14:00, and payroll locked at 12:00, a typical employee would not enter that UA on their own. They would add his explanation to the file, email and phone the manager, Gary, and payroll immediately to hold his line and stop the letter, and submit the rest of the list. If nobody answered in time, they still would not be the one who entered the second UA.
